messages.author: 519907adbbc83e48
messages.subject: gbm3 and OpenMP on Mac
parts:
I'm trying to help a Mac-using colleague use gbm3, but the Mac clang compiler doesn't seem to support openmp. Any of you successfully compile gbm3 on a Mac? I don't know my way around a Mac and am not sure where to point him. Not even sure how to tell him to try gcc instead, etc.

Greg



> library("devtools")

> install_github("gbm-developers/gbm3")

Downloading GitHub repo gbm-developers/gbm3@master from URL https://api.github.com/repos/gbm-developers/gbm3/zipball/master

Installing gbm3

'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save --no-restore --quiet CMD INSTALL  \

  '/private/var/folders/rl/0785fq111sj133wfrkdqcrm40000gn/T/Rtmpc5r1ul/devtools90e2e964a52/gbm-developers-gbm3-62de7c4'  \

  --library='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/library' --install-tests

 

* installing *source* package ‘gbm3’ ...

Warning in as.POSIXlt.POSIXct(x, tz) :

  unknown timezone 'default/America/New_York'

** libs

clang++  -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include -DNDEBUG 

clang++ -I"/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/librar

clang++ y/Rcpp/include" -I/usr/local/include  -fopenmp -fPIC  -Wall -g

clang++ -O2  -c adaboost.cpp -o adaboost.o

clang: error: unsupported option '-fopenmp'

make: *** [adaboost.o] Error 1

ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘gbm3’

* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/library/gbm3’

Installation failed: Command failed (1)

messages.author: 990bd78abe1370d4
messages.subject: Re: gbm3 and OpenMP on Mac
parts:
There's instructions on getting openmp to work on macos R at:

http://thecoatlessprofessor.com/programming/openmp-in-r-on-os-x/

I keep asking the world to buy me a Mac so I can test this out, but no luck yet. :-)

pdm
